content:
Lean-zh is an open-source project dedicated to providing simplified Chinese translations of documentation, tutorials, and community resources for Lean 4.
Our website is:
:point_right: https://www.leanprover.cn/

The goal of Lean-zh is to lower the entry barrier for Chinese speakers to learn and use Lean, and to help more people engage deeply with formal proof and the Lean ecosystem.

Recent updates:
We have recently synchronized several core Lean 4 tutorials with the latest versions, including:

  • :blue_book: Functional Programming in Lean 4
  • :blue_book: Theorem Proving in Lean 4

In addition, the following materials are now available in Chinese:

  • :blue_book: Metaprogramming in Lean 4
  • :blue_book: Mathematics in Lean 4
  • :blue_book: Type Checking in Lean 4
  • :puzzle_piece: And many community tool tutorials and practical guides!

Acknowledgements:

This project is made possible by many contributors. Special thanks to the main contributors, including @Oling Cat @RexWang .
There are also many friends active on Zulip whose IDs I don’t yet know :( . Please feel free to say hi!

Proofreading note:

Verso currently has limited support for multilingual projects. The current Verso-based site was automatically reconstructed using AI from older translations. Although we have done substantial manual cleanup, errors and inconsistencies may remain.
We warmly welcome help with proofreading, issue reports, and pull requests!

For Chinese speakers, Lean-zh provides both learning resources and a platform for practical engagement. Translation serves as an excellent entry point for collaboration and learning.
We're currently a small, passion-driven community group, and we look forward to contributing more valuable projects to the Lean ecosystem. :wink:
